name: Mali

flag.description: Three vertical stripes of green (hoist), yellow and red.
flag.symbolism: Green stands for hope and fertility, yellow for purity and mineral wealth, and red for the blood shed for independence.

hook: Mali is plain green-yellow-red verticals: Guinea in reverse, and Senegal without its green star.
trivia: The 1959-1961 flag had a black human figure, the kanaga, in the center; it was removed partly because of Islamic objections to images of people.
The Great Mosque of Djenné is the largest mud-brick building in the world.
